title: Pokémon Ranger
subtitle: A different job in Fiore
summary: Pokémon Ranger is HAL Laboratory and Creatures' Nintendo DS action role-playing adventure about protecting people, Pokémon and their surroundings. body: Pokémon Ranger is HAL Laboratory and Creatures' Nintendo DS action role-playing adventure about protecting people, Pokémon and their surroundings. Working in the Fiore region, the player completes a succession of Ranger missions rather than pursuing the usual Gym challenge. Wild Pokémon become temporary helpers whose abilities can remove obstacles or assist another capture. The handheld's stylus provides the central tool, the Capture Styler. A familiar collection of creatures is approached through a new profession, giving the player practical reasons to recognise what each one can do.

Capturing asks the player to draw consecutive circles around a moving Pokémon on the touchscreen. Its attacks threaten the Styler, so following the target is only part of the task: the next movement or warning also matters. Successfully completing the required loops recruits the creature temporarily. The direct gesture gives capture a different pace from choosing commands in a turn-based encounter. A Pokémon's position and behaviour become an immediate problem for the player's hand, with success depending on a sustained, careful movement around the screen.

A recruited Pokémon can use a Field Move to tackle a barrier, break a rock, burn an obstruction or solve another environmental problem. After providing that help, it leaves the party. Poké Assists can also support a capture, connecting the creatures already befriended to the next encounter. These temporary partnerships encourage attention to the area around a mission. The useful Pokémon nearby is part of the solution, and using its ability changes the group of helpers available for whatever the Ranger meets farther along the route.
